_leia: Pedidos dos retratos pintados. Gere com: python3 tools/arte_icones.py [ids...] [--seco] [--qualidade medium]. Cada pedido vai junto com o vetor do personagem (arte/referencia/<id>.png, feito por tools/referencias.js), para a versão pintada manter o desenho e o estilo do jogo. Os textos ficam em inglês porque o gerador entende melhor.
estilo: Dice Duel game avatar: a cozy flat sticker illustration that looks like a polished vector drawing. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. Head and shoulders, centered, facing the viewer, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels, charming but adult, not chibi, not childish. No text, no letters, no frame, plain transparent background.
especial: Special premium portrait: inside a dark plum circular medallion (#2e2330) with an antique-gold rim (#e2b04a), the character slightly overlapping the rim at the bottom.

retratos.diana: A white domestic cat named Diana with clear light-blue eyes, calm and confident expression. Exact markings that must be respected: the tip of HER RIGHT ear (on the viewer's left) is black, her left ear is entirely white; a very faint light-gray shading just above both eyes; two short darker gray horizontal stripes on the forehead, symmetric, one on each side of the center; a small red scratch wound across the bridge of the nose. Pink nose, white whiskers.
retratos.coruja: An old wise brown tawny owl lady, Dona Coruja, large round amber eyes with thin round reading-glasses rims, small ear tufts, a pale cream chest with a few feather chevrons. IMPORTANT: no line, curve or mark under the beak that could read as a mouth; the beak is the only feature below the eyes.
retratos.bolinha: A single ivory six-sided die with rounded corners, slightly tilted, five dark pips, soft shadow. No face.
retratos.xicara: A steaming porcelain teacup on a saucer, cream with a terracotta band, dark tea, soft steam. No face.
retratos.raposa: An anthropomorphic red fox with half-closed contented eyes wearing a dark-green knitted scarf.
retratos.sapo: An anthropomorphic green frog wearing a straw boater hat with a rust ribbon and a small rust bow tie.
retratos.urso: An anthropomorphic brown bear wearing a red knitted beanie with a cream pompom and cream rim.
retratos.coelho: An anthropomorphic light-gray rabbit with long ears and pink inner ears, wearing a navy bow tie.
retratos.guaxinim: An anthropomorphic raccoon with the classic black eye mask, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie.
retratos.cogumelo: A small cluster of forest mushrooms: one red cap with white spots and one small brown cap, a bit of moss. No faces.
retratos.monstera: A monstera leaf plant in a terracotta pot. No face.
retratos.cacto: A small saguaro-like cactus with one pink flower in a terracotta pot. No face.
retratos.biscoito: SPECIAL. A round chocolate-chip cookie character called Biscoito, with a messy tuft of golden-blond hair on top, big goofy smile showing one tooth, slightly mismatched eyes, a bit silly and very likable.
retratos.gordinho: SPECIAL. A chubby, big-bellied man called Gordinho, shown from the head down to the round belly: bald on top with a receding hairline (entradas), short brown hair only on the sides above the ears, and one single springy curl of hair sticking up from the top of the head. NO glasses. Rosy cheeks, half-lidded eyes glancing sideways, one eyebrow raised, a mischievous sideways smirk; cute and lovable rather than mean. Light-blue button shirt stretched over the belly, hands resting on the belly.
retratos.cafu: SPECIAL. A generic Brazilian footballer character, short dark hair, warm brown skin, big confident smile, wearing a canary-yellow football jersey with a green V collar and green trim, evoking Brazil. Not any real person; an original character.
retratos.galgo: SPECIAL. Galgo, a shrewd and witty anthropomorphic greyhound: long narrow elegant muzzle, rose ears folded back, slate-gray short coat with a white blaze down the face, narrowed amber eyes with a knowing look and slanted brows, a faint confident smirk, wide red martingale collar with a small gold tag.
retratos.bandoleiro: SPECIAL. A charming trickster gambler called Bandoleiro: wide-brimmed dark-brown hat with a playing card tucked in the band, one eye winking, thin curled mustache, sly grin with one gold tooth, red neckerchief, slate-blue coat.

referencia: Use the attached image as the exact design reference: keep the same character, pose, framing, markings, accessories and color choices, and redraw it as a more detailed finished illustration in the same visual language.
